text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'A false step is a rise of 10% of the real series' mean capacity within 4 weeks that the injected path does not contain. Dots: mean over replicates. Dotted and dashed lines: the plan's limits for the median Primary (0.5) and the worst Primary (1.0), or 0.05 for the drift. Four fits; the free fit is omitted because it gives constant-path false steps of 11 or more.'
text.tspan: A false step is a rise of 10% of the real series' mean capacity within 4 weeks that the
injected path does not contain. Dots: mean over replicates. Dotted and dashed lines: the
plan's limits for the median Primary (0.5) and the worst Primary (1.0), or 0.05 for the
drift. Four fits; the free fit is omitted because it gives constant-path false steps of 11
